site.aboutText: This site is a documentation of the Real Work Lecture (KKN) program by Bali State Polytechnic in Pejeng Village, Tampaksiring District, Gianyar Regency, in 2026. Pejeng Village is known as one of the historical areas in Bali that preserves ancient relics from past civilizations, including several temples that remain centers of spiritual activity for the community to this day. Through this site, the KKN team has compiled the history of five temples in Pejeng Village to make them more accessible and learnable for the wider community.

village.name: Pejeng Village
village.tagline: Ancient Balinese Heritage in the Heart of Gianyar
village.history: Pejeng Village is home to more than 30 historical temples scattered across every corner of the village, each with its own story and spiritual significance. From Penataran Sasih Temple, which holds the legend of the Pejeng Moon, Pusering Jagat Temple, believed to be the cosmological axis of Bali, to Kebo Edan Temple with its unique Tantrayana statue. This site summarizes the stories of five main temples in Pejeng Village — discover and explore the articles below to learn more about this ancestral heritage that still lives today.

pura-panataran-sasih.title: Panataran Sasih: Moon Worship Altar and Ancient Balinese Civilization
pura-panataran-sasih.excerpt: Exploring the meaning of "Penataran Sasih" as a moon worship altar, the Tri Mandala concept, and the Pejeng Moon Bronze Drum believed to be a medium for rain prayers since the ancient Balinese agrarian era.
pura-panataran-sasih.author: KKN Pejeng Village Team
pura-panataran-sasih.lokasi: Banjar Intaran, Pejeng Village, Tampaksiring, Gianyar
pura-panataran-sasih.periode: Origins since prehistoric times; temple structure took shape around the 9th-10th century AD (era of King Sri Kesari Warmadewa)
pura-panataran-sasih.pendiri: Associated with the reign of King Sri Kesari Warmadewa
pura-panataran-sasih.dewaUtama: Ida Sang Hyang Ratih (Goddess of the Moon) and Ida Bhatara Mahadewa

pura-pusering-jagat.title: Pusering Jagat: The Sad Kahyangan Temple at Bali's Center Point
pura-pusering-jagat.excerpt: Discover one of the six Sad Kahyangan Temples believed to be the cosmological center of Bali Island.
pura-pusering-jagat.author: KKN Pejeng Village Team
pura-pusering-jagat.lokasi: Jero Kuta Traditional Village, Pejeng, Tampaksiring, Gianyar
pura-pusering-jagat.pendiri: Not recorded in any ancient manuscripts

pura-kebo-edan.title: Kebo Edan: Traces of Tantrayana and the Siwa Bhairawa Statue in Pejeng
pura-kebo-edan.excerpt: Correcting the meaning of "Kebo Edan" and tracing the 3.6-meter Siwa Bhairawa statue, one of three Bhairawa statues in Indonesia, within the UNESCO cultural heritage area of Pakerisan-Petanu.
pura-kebo-edan.author: KKN Pejeng Village Team
pura-kebo-edan.lokasi: Banjar Intaran, Pejeng Village, Tampaksiring, Gianyar
pura-kebo-edan.periode: Singasari Kingdom era, around the 13th century AD (per temple priest account)
pura-kebo-edan.pendiri: Brought by Patih Kebo Parud, envoy of King Kertanagara of Singasari
